messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Alex Smith <alex.smith@senthealth.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@senthealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sentry Health - Deployment Bootcamp & Day-Zero Checklist

Morning Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. As discussed, we want to run a concise "bootcamp" for your infra and ops teams to validate connectivity and controls before we flip traffic to the private deployment. I put together a short day-zero checklist (attached) and proposed timeline. High level asks: 

- Confirm network CIDR allocations and allowed egress ranges
- Provide KMS admin/service-account owners and current IAM bindings
- Validate the tenant network diagram and confirm NAT/peering details
- Schedule a 60-min smoke run (sample traffic) and share results

Next steps: if you can confirm availability for the smoke run on Thursday 8/13 (window 10:00-12:00 PT) we'll lock it in. I've CC'd Ben and Kim for any infra gating items.

Attachments: sentry-dayzero-checklist.xlsx, tenant-network-diagram.pdf

Sean
Sean Gallagher
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com

From: Alex Smith <alex.smith@senthealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@senthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sentry Health - Deployment Bootcamp & Day-Zero Checklist

Thanks Sean — that works. A couple quick clarifications before we confirm the window: 

1) Egress: our security team wants to confirm whether Redwood needs outbound access to any fixed IPs for telemetry. We can open an allowlist but prefer a minimal set.
2) KMS: we currently use AWS KMS and have a delegated services role; will you need full admin or just encrypt/decrypt for the tenant key?

We can do the smoke run Thursday at 10:30 PT. I'll invite our infra leads. Sending the initial network diagram (attached) — please review and call out anything missing.

Alex
Alex Smith
Head of Platform Ops, Sentry Health
alex.smith@senthealth.com

Attachment: tenant-network-diagram.pdf

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Alex Smith <alex.smith@senthealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@senthealth.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sentry Health - Deployment Bootcamp & Day-Zero Checklist

Alex — perfect, thanks. Quick answers inline: 

- Egress: Redwood's control plane needs outbound to our metrics and update endpoints (we provide IP ranges). For the private runtime, only the control-plane egress matters; nothing else requires internet-egress from inference nodes unless you enable external integrations. Ben, Kim — I'll defer to you for the exact IP range and port list.
- KMS: we only require Encrypt/Decrypt permissions scoped to the tenant key; no full KMS admin is needed. We can sign an access-scoped role to reduce blast radius.

Ben / Kim, can you confirm the minimal egress set and draft a short IAM role policy we can hand to Sentry? Also, Kim — please attach the KMS binding template if available.

I'll schedule the smoke run for Thu 8/13 10:30 PT and send an invite.

Sean

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Alex Smith <alex.smith@senthealth.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@senthealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sentry Health - Deployment Bootcamp & Day-Zero Checklist

Hi all — attaching the KMS role template and a compact egress list. Summary below: 

Egress/IPs (minimal):
- control.redwood.com (TCP 443) — CIDR block: 34.210.11.0/24
- metrics.redwood.com (TCP 443) — CIDR block: 44.132.77.0/24
- updates.redwood.com (TCP 443) — CIDR block: 52.16.99.0/24

KMS permissions (recommended minimal):
- kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey on arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/tenant-key-id
- Trust relationship: allow role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-service-exec

I've attached: kms-access-roles.csv (role names + ARNs), and a short JSON IAM policy snippet inside the spreadsheet. Marissa — please capture this in the runbook and we'll use it during the smoke run checklist.

Kimberly Park
Senior Cloud Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com

Attachments: kms-access-roles.csv

All — quick update from our side after the smoke run this morning: 

- Network: NAT/peering validated, egress rules applied as requested. No packet loss observed during sample traffic.
- KMS: role created per template; key policy updated to include Redwood's service role.
- Certificate pinning: we saw one intermediate mismatch on the staging CA — fixed by our infra team.

We're comfortable moving to tenant activation Tuesday next week pending final confirmation from Security on retention settings. We've uploaded the signed checklist to the shared Drive and attached the redacted run results.

Attachments: sentry-dayzero-checklist.xlsx (signed), run-results-summary.txt

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Priya Rao
Platform Engineering Manager, Sentry Health
